Check a reader against the reader contract

Source: R/doc-read-check.R
gr_check_reader.Rd

Reads the bundled example document (gr_example()) with one registered reader, through an offline client, and reports which rules of the reader contract it breaks. Nothing is refused: a reader that fails a rule stays registered and runs as before. Use it on a reader of your own after gr_register_reader().

Usage

gr_check_reader(reader, client = NULL)

Arguments

reader

A registered reader's name; see gr_readers().

client

A gr_client to read with. NULL (the default) uses a gr_mock_client() whose reply to a request with a JSON schema is an object of that schema's shape, and a fixed sentence otherwise.

Value

An hr_conformance data frame; see hr_check_module().

Details

The document is cut with list(method = "paragraph", max_tokens = 150) and read on a fresh gr_trace(). Readers that need more than a question are given what they need: extract one field, screen one inclusion criterion, and ensemble the members "stuff" and "retrieve".

Rules

is_function, runs

The reader's fn is a function, and gr_read() with it finishes without an error.

answer_class

It returns a gr_answer.

answer_fields

The answer has every field gr_answer documents for gr_read(): answer, reader, question, chunks_used, partial, notes, trace, warnings and signature, with partial one TRUE or FALSE.

answer_text

answer is a single string, not NA.

evidence

evidence is NULL, or a data frame with a chunk_id column whose ids are all chunks of the input. NA is allowed, for a span placed in no chunk.

chunks_used

Every id in chunks_used is a chunk of the input.

calls_declared

The label of every model call in the trace is covered by a stem the reader declared in calls, by the rule an effort map is checked with (a stem, a part of one up to a dot, or a label under one). For ensemble, its members' stems count too.

calls_within_cost

The requests the run made, embeddings included, are no more than the worst case its cost function gave for this input, as the pre-flight check recorded it. NA for a reader registered without cost.

See also

hr_check_module(), gr_check_segmenter(), gr_register_reader()

Other reading functions: gr_answer, gr_read(), gr_read_spec(), gr_reader_signature(), gr_readers(), gr_register_reader(), is_not_found(), new_answer()

Examples

gr_check_reader("stuff")
#> Using cached ingestion for this document + settings.
#> Segmenting with 'paragraph' (cap 150 tokens, overlap 0).
#> Reading with 'stuff' (all|1|none) over 5 chunk(s).
#> <hr_conformance> reader 'stuff', contract 0.1
#>   passes all 9 rules
#>   ok    is_function
#>   ok    runs
#>   ok    answer_class
#>   ok    answer_fields
#>   ok    answer_text
#>   ok    evidence
#>   ok    chunks_used
#>   ok    calls_declared: 1 call(s), all under declared stems
#>   ok    calls_within_cost: 1 request(s) made, at most 1 expected

# A reader whose calls carry a label it did not declare.
gr_register_reader("loose", signature = "one|1|none", calls = "loose.answer",
  fn = function(chunks, question, client, spec, trace) {
    res <- gr_call(client, list(list(role = "user", content = question)),
                   model = spec$model, trace = trace, label = "other.answer")
    new_answer(res$text, "loose", question, integer(0), trace)
  })
gr_check_reader("loose")
#> Using cached ingestion for this document + settings.
#> Segmenting with 'paragraph' (cap 150 tokens, overlap 0).
#> Reading with 'loose' (one|1|none) over 5 chunk(s).
#> <hr_conformance> reader 'loose', contract 0.1
#>   fails 1 of 9 rules
#>   FAIL  calls_declared: label(s) 'other.answer' not under the declared stems loose.answer
#>   skip  calls_within_cost: not checked: no cost function declared
#>   ok    is_function
#>   ok    runs
#>   ok    answer_class
#>   ok    answer_fields
#>   ok    answer_text
#>   ok    evidence: no evidence
#>   ok    chunks_used
